title: Certify the 256-function table with DRAT
statement: For each function and each instruction set, a DRAT refutation at Len-1. ~10^3 vars per function; <1 GB total. The answer is already known (M.riscv.bitlogic256); only the proof is missing. Effort estimate: days.
